name: Looteri Dulhan
overview: Set across the Hindi heartland, Looteri Dulhan follows suspended police officer Sandhya Yadav as she chases Maya, a sharp and emotionally scarred con bride who targets wealthy men through fake marriages and disappears after looting them. As the investigation deepens from small-town Madhya Pradesh to Lucknow, the hunt slowly transforms into an emotional battle between two women shaped by survival, betrayal and difficult choices.
